# Informal Engineer

> A lab that publishes engineered guides, lab notes, and research for people
> who build their own infrastructure: homelab, self-hosted AI, networking,
> and the tools around them. Everything tested, numbers included: every guide
> carries a Tested-on block (hardware, named software versions, date), a
> changelog, and measured costs in CAD. Run by Mesh Rahman (P.Eng), whose
> personal site is https://meshrahman.com.

Products: curated hardware kits with affiliate links and measured costs
(/kits), and Northstack managed hosting for self-hosted apps (/northstack).

## Sections

- [Guides](https://informalengineer.com/guides/): tested procedures, filterable by Homelab / Self-hosted AI / Networking / Tools
- [Lab Notes](https://informalengineer.com/notes/): short dated notes, status badges TESTING / WORKS / ABANDONED / SHIPPED
- [Kits](https://informalengineer.com/kits/): exact parts lists from real builds
- [Northstack](https://informalengineer.com/northstack/): managed hosting waitlist
- [Research](https://informalengineer.com/research/): standing research lines with structured write-ups
- [About](https://informalengineer.com/about/): editorial standards and the Tteck dedication
- [Newsletter](https://informalengineer.com/newsletter/): Lab Notes weekly
- Full-content RSS: https://informalengineer.com/rss.xml

## Guides

- [Build a website with Ghost, Cloudflare, and DigitalOcean](https://informalengineer.com/guides/ghost-cloudflare-digitalocean/): self-hosting a Ghost blog end to end
- [My Cursor AI workflow](https://informalengineer.com/guides/cursor-ai-workflow/): practical AI-assisted coding setup and habits
